Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class InitSystemService

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService
public final class InitSystemService extends Object
Init-system abstraction for the LFS/BLFS system managers: it detects which service supervisor the running system uses (systemd, openrc, runit, s6 or plain sysvinit) and maps a logical service operation onto that supervisor's native command line.

This is a thin front-end helper, normative in system-management-contract.md §4.1. It never re-implements service logic: buildCommand(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.InitSystem, org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.Operation, java.lang.String) only produces an argument vector (no shell interpolation) that the caller runs through ProcessRunner (read-only operations) or PrivilegedRunner (mutating operations, escalated with polkit). The detection and command mapping mirror the builder's lfs/06b-service-management.sh abstraction layer verbatim.

The detection and command-building logic is pure and unit-testable (detect(Probes), buildCommand(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.InitSystem, org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.InitSystemService.Operation, java.lang.String)); the live detect() probe and the run* helpers are thin wrappers that degrade gracefully (an unknown init or an unsupported operation yields an empty vector rather than throwing).

  • Method Details

    • detect

      public static InitSystemService.InitSystem detect(InitSystemService.Probes p)
      Pure detection from a set of probes, in the same order as the builder's _detect_init: systemd, then openrc, then runit, then s6, then a sysvinit fallback. Returns InitSystemService.InitSystem.UNKNOWN only when even the sysvinit /etc/init.d directory is absent (nothing to drive).

    • detect

      public static InitSystemService.InitSystem detect()
      Live detection against this host: probes PATH for each supervisor tool and the filesystem for its service directory, then defers to detect(Probes).

    • isMutating

      public static boolean isMutating(InitSystemService.Operation op)
      True if op changes system state and therefore needs polkit.

    • isSupported

      public static boolean isSupported(InitSystemService.InitSystem init, InitSystemService.Operation op)
      True if init supports op. SysV init has no enable/disable (the builder reports "not supported"), and InitSystemService.InitSystem.UNKNOWN supports nothing.

    • buildCommand

      public static List<String> buildCommand(InitSystemService.InitSystem init, InitSystemService.Operation op, String service)
      Builds the argument vector for op on init, targeting service. Returns an empty list when the operation is unsupported or the arguments are invalid; the result never contains shell metacharacters and is meant to be handed straight to ProcessRunner / PrivilegedRunner.

      InitSystemService.Operation.LIST ignores service.

    • runRead

      public static ProcessRunner.Result runRead(InitSystemService.InitSystem init, InitSystemService.Operation op, String service)
      Runs a read-only operation (STATUS or LIST) unprivileged through ProcessRunner. Returns a not-started ProcessRunner.Result when the operation is unsupported or mutating.

    • runMutating

      public static PrivilegedRunner.PrivilegedResult runMutating(InitSystemService.InitSystem init, InitSystemService.Operation op, String service)
      Runs a mutating operation (START/STOP/RESTART/ENABLE/DISABLE) with polkit escalation through PrivilegedRunner. Returns an ERROR result when the operation is unsupported or read-only.

    • listServices

      public static List<String> listServices(InitSystemService.InitSystem init)
      Lists the known services for init, read-only. Returns an empty list when listing is unsupported or the supervisor is absent. For the directory-enumeration backends (runit/s6/sysvinit) this is the trimmed ls output; for systemd/openrc it is the raw status lines the panel can render or further parse.

    • listServiceEntries

      public static List<InitSystemService.ServiceEntry> listServiceEntries(InitSystemService.InitSystem init)
      Lists the known services for init and parses each raw output line into a InitSystemService.ServiceEntry. Read-only; returns an empty list when listing is unsupported or the supervisor is absent.

    • parseServiceList

      public static List<InitSystemService.ServiceEntry> parseServiceList(InitSystemService.InitSystem init, List<String> rawLines)
      Parses the raw stdout lines of a InitSystemService.Operation.LIST command into InitSystemService.ServiceEntry values, per init system. The exact shape differs by supervisor:
      • systemd list-units --no-legend: UNIT LOAD ACTIVE SUB DESCRIPTION - the name is the unit minus its .service suffix and the state is ACTIVE SUB.
      • openrc rc-status --all: name | state - lines without a | (runlevel headers) are skipped.
      • runit / s6 / sysvinit ls: each line is a bare service name with no state.
      Blank and null lines are dropped; parsing never throws.
